title: Editorial portfolio
description: Build a personal portfolio for a writer/editor. Long-form typography, project list, contact.
prompt: Build a portfolio for a writer/editor named Adaora Onyemaechi. Long-form typography, a list of three recent pieces with a one-line summary each, a short bio, and a contact block. Tone: editorial, calm, no emoji.

rubric.label: Type system tuned for long-form reading
rubric.guidance: Comfortable measure and leading, not a UI default.

rubric.label: Bio is concrete, not a list of adjectives
Contact block is understated
rubric.guidance: Email, mastodon, or form — no splashy CTA.
